Dear Hafeez,

Thank you for your response and for sharing your requirements with us.

We would like to inform you that, unfortunately, we do not currently have a 2-bedroom apartment available in your preferred areas of Jumeirah or DIFC that matches your requirements.

However, we do have a spacious 2-bedroom apartment available in Viridian by Central Park, City Walk, which may be a suitable alternative for you.

Property: Viridian by Central Park – City Walk

Link: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-city-walk-central-park-at-city-walk-viridian-2PuwDDpSs0u.html

Please have a look at the property, and if it suits your requirements, let us know. We will be happy to assist you further with the availability and rates.

Thank you.
